id.description: Stable identity used in opencode.json under vsworker.plugins, and in the CLI

source.description: npm registry package, GitHub repository, or a plugin vendored under vsworker/plugins

package.description: npm package name, required for npm and github sources

version.description: Exact version to pin, required for npm sources

ref.description: Full 40 character commit sha to pin, required for github sources

path.description: Entrypoint relative to vsworker/, for local sources. Defaults to plugins/<id>/index.ts

kind.description: Force the plugin kind instead of detecting it from the package exports

enabled.description: Include this plugin in the build. Defaults to true. False removes it from the bundle entirely

defaultEnabled.description: Run this plugin unless a user turns it off. Defaults to true

options.description: Options passed to the plugin, overridable per user in opencode.json
